about: The character sheet is React (src/components/CharacterSheet/CharacterSheet.jsx renders the modal frame; engine.js, moved verbatim by tools/extract-engine.js, draws the sheet). tools/split-map.js drops the code and modal below. It owns the sheet mode both sheets share (SHEET_MODE, sheetEditable, paintSheetModeButtons, toggleSheetMode) and slotUpload. csImg stays in core (plateSrc, which every page uses, calls it). PROVIDED: openCharacterSheet and renderCharacterSheet (the Characters cards, core's inspector), toggleSheetMode, sheetEditable and slotUpload (the location and prop sheet).
